snippet_primary: "Your file size limit depends on how you've decided to price your product. Free products have a file size limit of 250 MB. Products priced higher than $1 have a file size limit of 16 GB. If you price your product at any number greater than $0.99, the largest single file that you can upload to a product is 16 GB in size. We rarely see anyone upload files larger than 5GB, so that shouldn't be an issue for the vast majority of creators. Remember, you can add as many files as you want to each product."
